result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders mostly well. Found a few minor layout and content issues related to cut-off elements in horizontal carousels.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the 'Trattoria Piccol...' card on the right edge is cut off, truncating both the restaurant name and image.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for a scrollable carousel, but consider adding a partial-peek indicator or padding to make it clearer the content scrolls horizontally.

issues.description: The cards in the 'Fastest near you' row have inconsistent vertical alignment — the burger card image is taller and extends higher than the adjacent poké card, causing an uneven top edge.
issues.suggestion: Standardize image container heights across carousel cards so all items align consistently.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card under 'Popular right now' is partially cut off by the viewport, showing only the top portion with a '-20%' badge and no title or details.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate bottom spacing or lazy-load so partial cards don't appear truncated at the fold; this is generally acceptable scroll behavior.
